item.title: Culmina inédita reunión entre Xi, Trump y Putin en la cumbre de la APEC
item.description: El presidente chino, Xi Jinping, y sus homólogos estadounidense, Donald Trump, y ruso, Vladimir Putin, se reunieron este 19 de noviembre en Shenzhen en un encuentro inédito, en el marco de la cumbre del Foro de Cooperación Económica Asia-Pacífico (APEC). Una hora y 20 minutos después, los mandatarios instaron a la paz, la estabilidad, el compromiso y el diálogo. Putin habló sobre la guerra en Ucrania; Xi, sobre el fortalecimiento de las relaciones con Estados Unidos, y Trump, sobre el estrecho de Ormuz y la guerra en Irán. Nuestro enviado especial, Adrián Foncillas, nos amplió la información. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Apec brings world leaders and probably 2 ‘nuclear briefcases’ to Shenzhen
item.description: World leaders have descended on the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen for the Apec summit, and two of them likely brought their “nuclear button” with them. item.title: "Bandas carcelarias están transformando a Ecuador en un narcoestado": 'WSJ'
item.description: En Revista de Prensa analizamos una investigacion del diario 'Wall Street Journal' sobre las operaciones de las bandas de narcotráfico desde las cárceles en Ecuador. El medio financiero señala que los grupos criminales convirtieron al país que supo ser el más pacífico de América Latina en una arteria vital del tráfico mundial de cocaína, demostrando el fracaso del modelo de militarización del presidente Daniel Noboa. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Dacil Lanza

item.title: Live Updates: Trump, Xi and Putin Shake Hands as Leaders Gather in China
item.description: China’s leader, Xi Jinping, earlier hugged President Trump on the tarmac as he arrived for a regional summit in Shenzhen. They are expected to hold a trilateral meeting on Thursday with President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia. Fuente: The New York Times - World.

item.title: China’s first lady Peng Liyuan again lets her English do the talking in welcoming Trump
item.description: Chinese first lady Peng Liyuan again let her English do the talking as she accompanied President Xi Jinping in welcoming his US counterpart Donald Trump and other leaders to Shenzhen for the Apec summit’s welcome dinner. On Wednesday night, leaders gathered at the Shenzhen International Communication Centre for a welcome banquet and cultural gala ahead of Thursday’s main meeting at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation event. Peng arrived in her classic understated style: a light pink dress with... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Israel delays building contracts for West Bank settlement after UK sanctions
item.description: Attorney general says E1 settlement decision should not be taken by caretaker government led by Netanyahu Israel has postponed issuing contracts for the construction of a large settlement on the West Bank seen as likely to render a two-state solution unviable, days after the UK imposed sanctions against building firms operating in the area. Israeli diplomats insisted the move was not in response to the measures from Downing Street .
